reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Headless UI (https://headlessui.com/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, javascript, typescript.
Component specification: 最后开 React 对话框。演示开着，安装命令在下面。
Key visual & interaction patterns: Dialog、Checkbox、Combobox、Switch.
Visual details from source observation: 我们进首页，React 标签亮着，下面下拉菜单、折叠、对话框三张预览在动。Vue 是旁边一个切换，本条只收 React。点开 Dialog，Payment successful 演示开着，安装写 npm install @headlessui/react。适合要无障碍行为、样式交给 Tailwind 的人。MIT 免费；页脚 Tailwind Plus 是另售模板。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
